title: Apocalypse
predictedRatingReason: Predicted 3.5★: UK survival format dropping 14 ordinary people into a mock apocalyptic town for 28 days, two groups initially unaware of each other. Similar to Survivor (4★), the one rated unscripted show that landed, and matches Alone (3.5★) as a format comp. Trakt 6.5 rests on 4 votes and early reviews are divided — treat the numbers as UNKNOWN, not low. Main risk is mid-run sag once scavenging turns repetitive. Returning, 8-part first season. Together: reality competition is the established shared class, no genre triggers. Strict 2-episode test.
predictedBingeabilityReason: Binge 4/5: Eight 55-minute episodes with a 28-day countdown spine, plus a hidden second group as a reveal engine — structural momentum a pure endurance format lacks. Episodes run longer than ideal and deprivation can turn samey mid-run. Grabs from ep 1.
